metin.SexyKO'da bulunan **Tag Name Sistemi** s: With the **Tag Name System** in SexyKO you can show a special name / tag above your character and customize it fully in your own style.
metin.Sistem, iteme **sağ tıklayarak** kolayca: The system is easily activated by **right-clicking** the item — no need to visit an extra NPC.
metin.TAG NAME NASIL KULLANILIR?: HOW TO USE THE TAG NAME?
metin.Tag Name itemine **sağ tıklayarak** aşağ: **Right-click** the Tag Name item to open the settings window below.
metin.Bu bölümden karakterinizin üzerinde görü: Here you can set the Tag Name you want to appear above your character.
metin.**2️⃣ Açılan pencereden isminizi belirle: **2️⃣ Set your name in the window that opens**
metin.Tag Name'inizi sadece yazı olarak değil,: You can use your Tag Name not just as text but in any color you want through the **RGB color system**.
metin.RGB değerlerini değiştirerek:: By changing the RGB values you can create:
metin.Bu sayede karakterinizin üzerindeki Tag: This gives the Tag Name above your character a look that's completely your own.
metin.KARAKTER ÜZERİNDE NASIL GÖRÜNÜR?: HOW DOES IT LOOK ON THE CHARACTER?
metin.Ayarladığınız Tag Name, karakterinizin ü: The Tag Name you set is shown directly above your character.
metin.Böylece oyuncular karakterinizi gördüğün: So when players see your character, the special tag / name you chose appears along with it.
metin.Bu sistem özellikle karakterini daha özg: This system was made especially for players who want to make their character more unique and eye-catching.
metin.SexyKO Tag Name sistemi sayesinde:: With the SexyKO Tag Name system:
metin.iteme **sağ tıklayarak** sistemi açabili: you can open the system by **right-clicking** the item,
metin.karakteriniz için özel bir Tag Name beli: you can set a special Tag Name for your character,
metin.RGB sistemiyle istediğiniz rengi oluştur: you can create any color you want with the RGB system,
metin.seçtiğiniz Tag Name'i karakterinizin üze: you can show the Tag Name you chose above your character.
metin.**İsmini belirle • Rengini seç • Tarzını: **Set your name • Pick your color • Show your style on your character!**
metin.Kendi rengin, kendi Tag Name'in, kendi s: Your own color, your own Tag Name, your own style.
